knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The walk-through maps supplies, waste points and hazards before work begins. It is not a speed or pricing exercise.
Out-of-scope items are recorded and confirmed with the site contact. The worker does not decide scope alone.
The safety data sheet for the specific product holds the handling and first aid information. Packaging of other products and memory are not reliable sources.

practicalCriteria: Completes a site walk-through with the site contact and records the storage room, waste points, emergency numbers, safety data sheet location and closing routine on a site card.
Lists at least one question for the site contact where the scope is unclear.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Work starts before the walk-through and scope check
A product is used before its safety data sheet has been located
